## ⚠️ Troubleshooting

### Browser Popup Issues
If the form doesn't open:
1. Look for a popup blocker icon in your browser's address bar
2. Click it and select "Always allow popups from this site"
3. Refresh the page and try again

### Executable Path Issues
If conversion fails, ensure you're using the correct path:

✅ **Correct path:**
```
C:\DDC\cad2data-Revit-IFC-DWG\DDC_WINDOWS_Converters\DDC_RVT_Converter\cli\RVTconverter.exe
```

❌ **Incorrect path:**
```
C:\DDC\cad2data-Revit-IFC-DWG\DDC_WINDOWS_Converters\DDC_RVT_Converter\cli\RVTconverter.exe

### Option 1: Manual Variables
- Click **"Manual Trigger"** to use pre-configured variables
- Modify the variables in the **"Set Variables"** node as needed

## 🔧 Configuration
- Update the **RVTconverter.exe** path in the form or variables
- Point `path_to_revit_converter` to `DDC_WINDOWS_Converters\DDC_RVT_Converter\cli\RVTconverter.exe` and install `ddc` once: `pip install "C:\DDC\cad2data-Revit-IFC-DWG\ddc-tools"`

### Option 2: Form UI
- Activate and click **"Form UI"** to open the web form
- Fill in your converter path and Revit file path
- Select the converter options (properties, IFC, glTF, OBJ, IFC profile and unit, categories)

parameters.content:
## 📋 Options Guide

The workflow runs two commands: the RVT converter, then `ddc table` on its folder (result: `<file>_rvt.xlsx`, sheet `Project_Data`).

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--properties` | writes `properties.jsonl` (stored parameters). Always added, the table needs it |
| `--ifc` | also writes `native_graph.ifc` (IFC4): category, family, type and level names, quantities. Recommended |
| `--gltf` / `--obj` | extra 3D formats next to the GLB (`native_graph.glb` is always written) |
| `--neutral` | neutral appearance instead of the source colours |
| `--timings` | stage timings in `timings.json` |
| IFC profile | `full`, `coordination`, `geometry`, `custom` (`--ifc-profile`) |
| IFC length unit | `m` or `mm` (`--ifc-units`) |
| Categories | `--ifc-categories`, comma-separated BuiltInCategory ids or English names |

The old modes `basic/standard/complete`, `bbox`, `schedule`, `sheets2pdf`, `-no-xlsx` and `-no-collada` do not exist in the new converter. `cli\RVTconverter.exe --help` lists everything it accepts. The output folder must not exist yet.
